item.title: Two African houses constructed at Seville Heritage Park in St.Ann by Ghanaian gov’t handed over to Jamaica
item.description: Two African Houses were officially handed over to Jamaica by the Government of Ghana today, as part of a cultural heritage initiative aimed at strengthening historical ties between the two nations. The houses were constructed by the Ghana Army Reconstruction Team assisting with Hurricane Melissa recovery efforts.
